button.name: action_apply
button.confirm: Move all reviewed stock into the new warehouse? Existing products are reused; missing products and storage locations are created. Verify your backup and pause inventory activity first. If you chose to leave old operations behind, their reviewed reservations are released, including picked items. Old orders, deliveries and manufacturing jobs remain open: do not process them or apply old draft counts after this move. Uninstalling does not undo the move.

sheet.h1: Move stock to a new company

div.strong: Step 1 of 2: Choose where the stock moves.
div.p: Choose the old warehouse, new company and new warehouse. Then click 1. Check stock and review. Checking does not move stock or create products.

sheet.div: Completed. Stock was added to the selected destination warehouse. Use View completed stock move to check quantities, values, lots and posted entries. Originals and historical documents remain in the old company.

details.summary: Resolve a product match (only if the check asks you)

group.p: If Preview finds several matches, add the source product and choose the existing destination product here. Leave all other products automatic. Neither matching product needs deleting.

Choose where a source location's stock should go inside the destination warehouse. Leave other locations automatic. Several source locations can use the same destination. Unmapped child locations follow their mapped parent; missing children are created.

sheet.div: Confirm will RELEASE the reviewed reservations inside the Source warehouse. This includes Picked lines. Recorded on-hand quantities are moved; draft stock counts are not applied or copied. Old deliveries, orders and manufacturing operations remain OPEN in the old company; they are not transferred or cancelled. Do not process them after cutover. Do not apply old draft counts after cutover. Preview does not release anything. Other warehouse reservations remain unchanged.

div.strong: Step 2 of 2: Review the stock before moving it.
div.p: Check each product's Create or Reuse result and quantity below. Matched products receive additional stock, not duplicate product records. Ambiguous matches must be resolved before confirming. Check Already in new company, Moving now and New company total before confirming. Have your administrator verify the backup and pause inventory activity before clicking 2. Move reviewed stock.
div.details: Accounting and product setup details Normal currency rounding is accepted when quantities and total values reconcile. Fractional unit costs and later individual COGS entries may differ slightly; rounding is recorded in Stock Reconciliation. Shared-product barcodes remain on the originals and are blank on the new copies. New inventory categories preserve the source costing and valuation methods and use the Target Company's stock accounts. Existing FIFO products can receive Standard Cost source stock at its carried value; destination costing is not changed. Periodic valuation moves stock value but does not post automatic journal entries; handle the general-ledger inventory adjustment separately. Product families also create their unstocked sibling variants; the total is shown below. Recipes/BoMs, suppliers, packaging, POS links, custom routes and reordering rules need separate setup. If the same item has stock in other Source warehouses, its cost uses the company-wide FIFO pool; those other quantities stay where they are. Stock left in other warehouses can be moved in a later batch. Review the Left elsewhere column before confirming.

details.summary: Before you move: requirements and items handled separately
details.p: Both companies must be enabled in the company switcher. FIFO, Average Cost and Standard Price are supported without changing the originals. Perpetual products need valid stock-account configuration. Negative stock, consignment and packages need separate handling. Choose "Move recorded stock; leave old operations behind" to leave draft counts and unfinished operations in the old company, including Picked operations. Products with variant exclusions require separate review. This is an opening-stock cutover, not a transfer of historical transactions.

field.name: help
field.p: Move a warehouse into its replacement company
Choose source and destination warehouses. Preview all stock, reuse matching products and create only missing products and child locations.
